description: Brought the bucket, answered work with debt, and named the way home.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Kept the bent nail, and tried for the bucket.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Did the shout, and split the three things so they would not be traded.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Named the cooper's plot, and stopped the unasked answer.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Dropped the joinery when Susanna stopped him, and took the bucket.
name: William Shakespeare
